component.name: modman
component.summary: Nexus Mods manager for Steam and Proton games

description.p: modman installs, orders and deploys mods from Nexus Mods for Steam and Proton games on Linux and the Steam Deck. It handles FOMOD installers, collections, LOOT plugin sorting and nxm:// download links.
The package ships the desktop app and the modman command-line tool.
